methodology.candidate_universe: candidate_economics plus candidates rejected by the live cooldown, deduplicated by decision candle and candidate id
methodology.entry_price: BUY ask; SELL bid; executable estimate
methodology.exit_price: BUY bid; SELL ask; executable estimate
methodology.incomplete_day_policy: leave positions open and report executable mark-to-market at the final recorded tick
methodology.portfolio_order: cooldown -> current economics/router/models -> MANAGED gates -> top-N -> risk/capacity with no backfill -> order estimate
methodology.post_trade_costs: explicit fees only; no second spread deduction

managed_outcome_provenance.label_definition: minute OHLC replay of current TP/SL, breakeven, trailing, stale and session close; managed_positive >= 5bp net
